label: Learning

label: Learning
text: **Line = location type, not area.** ([line-supply](../concepts/line-supply.md))

label: Learning

Return NULL `[ELIMINATED]` and raise the decision ([open-decisions](../open-decisions.md)) — do not approximate.

label: Learning
text: **ODBC -155** is a driver limit, not a SQL error. ([connect](../connect.md))

label: Learning
text: **Wrappers hide Oracle.** `SYS_get_RTCIS`/`SYS_get_DAS`/`OpenQuery` carry Oracle text with `{n}` placeholders and doubled quotes; transliterate before judging. DAS is a history archive, not on the replica. ([method](../method.md))

label: Learning
text: **Downstream queries** (R12 on `RPM_System`) need no rewrite once their feeders are converted.

label: Learning
text: **Execution ≠ equivalence.** Graded only after same-object comparison. ([criteria](../criteria.md))

label: Learning
text: **Every RTCIS original file may have a second statement after `/*END*/`** — convert it too, and check the deliverable contains what the report claims (analysed-in-report ≠ shipped-in-artefact).

label: Learning
text: **Two queries were delivered the wrong way round** (Euskirchen Q02/Q11): verify header/item roles from the Oracle source.

label: Learning
text: **Scalar aggregates invent answers** (Q06 `IsPartial`): an aggregate over zero rows returns a row.

label: Learning
text: **`subsit='1'` is a site number, not a constant** — parameterise as warehouse.

label: Learning
text: **`CONCAT()` turns NULL into ''** — a missing setup printed a bare `/`; guard with CASE.

label: Learning
text: **Scanned-pallet queries need LEFT JOIN** for new joins, or a pallet with no list-pick work vanishes from the label run.

label: Learning
text: **Never hard-code a measured count into prose** — row counts are perishable snapshots; regenerate.

label: Learning
text: **The HTML may render cached SQL** — rebuild the data JSON after editing delivered SQL.

label: Learning
text: **Pass must be graded**, never boolean ([criteria](../criteria.md)).

label: Learning
text: **Match the original's data type, not just its value.** RTCIS quantities are `numeric(22,0)`; a correct division still disagrees when PrIME keeps 1/1000 units. Read `sys.columns` precision/scale of every original output.

label: Learning
text: **Measure the unit before declaring absence.** Pallet height was declared unmappable after assuming metres; PrIME dims are cm and the mapping exists. Test the unit on an item class with real data (FERT), then check placeholders (`1 × 1 × 1`) on the class you need ([pallet-dimensions](../concepts/pallet-dimensions.md)).

label: Learning
text: **Use the house reference queries** (CL_LATEST, IRA) as a second witness for location/count logic — they gave R17 a better item-class rule ([cl-ira-references](../sources/cl-ira-references.md)).

label: Learning
text: **A new join can wreck the plan**: two pre-aggregated CTEs joined into a 28k-row query took >5 min at DE08 until `LEFT HASH JOIN` — time every changed query on the target, not only the probe.

label: Learning
text: **Check every field, not every query** (2026-10-21): `field_check.py` lists 212 output fields with source, fill % and agreement. 44 were empty or mismatched; probing each found 3 real defects the query-level checks missed.

label: Learning
text: **"Filled" is not "right"**: R05/R06 door was 100% filled with `trlr.STOLOC` = the trailer's own id (TRL0000302, type DSPCH). The door is `trlr.YARD_LOC` (DOOR16/17, type RSDK). Always read sample values next to the percentages.

label: Learning
text: **Pick a column that is actually populated**: R16 `invlod.LSTDTE` is set on 303 of 97,793 DE08 pallets (only after a move) → `COALESCE(LSTDTE, ADDDTE)`. Probe the fill rate of the chosen column and its alternatives before mapping.

label: Learning
text: **Two blanks are not a match**: R07 Vendor Lot "agreed" 8,792/8,792 because both sides were empty. Agreement now excludes both-blank pairs.

label: Learning
text: **Test like for like**: the R06 PrIME test load held a FERT item, so the packaging-only fields came back NULL — exactly as the original would. Choosing a packaging receipt at a door (as RTCIS did) filled them.

label: Learning
text: **Location differences are mostly naming, not moves**: 11,142 of 13,588 differing Euskirchen pallets sit in CIMAT automated-store bins that do not exist as PrIME locations; only 1,692 moved. See also [verification-discipline](verification-discipline.md), [prime-anti-patterns](prime-anti-patterns.md), [ruiz-rs-obs](../experts/ruiz-rs-obs.md). Older learnings (IRA V5–V9, London, Athens schema, M&M bot, codebook value maps) are summarised in [kb](../sources/kb.md).

label: Learning
text: Never declare a field "does not exist" after searching only **column names**. PrIME stores concepts as **rows** discriminated by a value (GTIN = `alt_prtmst` row with `ALT_PRT_TYP='GTIN'`).

label: Learning
text: Before claiming absence: (1) column names, (2) **value domains** (`SELECT typcol, COUNT(*) GROUP BY typcol`), (3) KB / `raw/schema/verified-mappings.json`, (4) the **synonym space** (`REL_GRP`, `ALT_`, `VC_` prefixes, `_TMPL`/`_ID` suffixes — kits are `VC_PALLET_REL_GRP`), (5) the platform's own documentation vocabulary. Then say "not found with method X".

label: Learning
text: **Absence in a live system is evidence**: if Athens prints labels daily without column X, X is not the mechanism.

label: Learning
text: **A row count is not a fact until you know its grain**: 1,740 `dscmst lblfmt` rows = 116 codes × 15 locales. Run `COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT key), COUNT(DISTINCT locale)` first. Read the key before the count.

label: Learning
text: **"No rows" usually means wrong join**: compare key length/case/padding/prefix/check digit (ULID 19 vs LODNUM 20). `SELECT LEN(key), COUNT(*) GROUP BY LEN(key)` on both sides.

label: Learning
text: **EMPTY vs BLOCKED vs SKIP** are three different zeros ([criteria](../criteria.md)).

label: Learning
text: Sampling `ORDER BY id DESC` surfaces test rows (TM…, 0012345678…) — use a shape filter.

label: Learning
text: **A test that cannot fail is not evidence** — prove each check with a negative control.

label: Learning
text: If a harness constructs a key, **assert the round trip**. Discovery must mirror the predicates of the query it feeds. Never judge fallback data against the intended expectation — mark SKIP.

label: Learning
text: A **0-byte script exits 0** — check file size after creating scripts; add a "NOTHING RAN" guard.

label: Learning
text: A regression guard must **own its evidence** (deterministic ORDER BY), not depend on drifting live data.

label: Learning
text: A **live witness drifts**: A/B on one connection seconds apart; compare row **sets**, not counts.

label: Learning
text: **Compiling is not executing** (`SET NOEXEC ON` hides real defects; ODBC -155).

label: Learning
text: A green check proves only what it **covers** — print its scope and what it cannot check. A phantom failure is worse than no check. Mis-scoped checks create false gaps.

label: Learning
text: **Shape-based sweeps miss shapeless defects** — only column-by-column comparison finds a wrong ordinary column.

label: Learning
text: **Reapply a fix as a rule, not a text substitution**: ask where the same *mistake* appears in other clothes; report where the rule did **not** apply, and why.

label: Learning
text: **Diagnosis ≠ prescription**: a tiebreaker that makes a tie disappear may pick the wrong value; find the missing attribute (IRA V7: `prtmst.vc_itmgrp`). Consistency without correctness is wrong.

label: Learning
text: **A fabricated runtime input is worse than a fabricated value** — it silently narrows scope.

label: Learning
text: **Placeholders must be impossible to mistake for data** (`'<UNMAPPED>'`, typed NULL), never `'0/0'`.

label: Learning
text: `int/int` truncates on SQL Server where Oracle NUMBER does not — cast before dividing.

label: Learning
text: **Never sanitise data** (`encode('ascii','replace')` turned Greek addresses into `?????`). Sanitise only the console. Watch NBSP (U+00A0) in master data.

label: Learning
text: **Never hand-edit a generated artefact** — fix builder + data, rebuild, re-verify.
